name: Creality Ender-3 V3 SE 0.6 nozzle
pre_gcode: M190 S{bed_temp} ;Set and wait for bed temp to stabilize
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ;Move Z Axis up
G1 X-2.1 Y20 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move to start position
M109 S{temp} ;Wait for nozzle temp to stabilize
G1 X-2.1 Y145.0 Z0.28 F1500.0 E15 ;Draw the first line
G1 X-2.4 Y145.0 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move to side a little
G1 X-2.4 Y20 Z0.28 F1500.0 E30 ;Draw the second line
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ;Move Z Axis up
post_gcode: G1 E-2 Z0.2 F2400 ;Retract and raise Z
M84 X Y E ;Disable all steppers but Z
fan_gcode: M106 S{fan_speed}  ; p3d: add for orca slicer
